integrity: The stated probabilities, transition arithmetic and rational function were recomputed with exact binomial arithmetic and finite enumeration. Infinite-scale conclusions follow from the accompanying proof; no external or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only integer Fourier frequencies are classified. The family result is a finite rational algorithm, not a closed expression uniform in the number of digits. Equivalent early literature results cannot be entirely excluded, particularly inaccessible full text of a 1993 self-similar Fourier-transform paper.
title: Rational Fourier-null densities of dyadic simplex measures, with an exact eight-atom law
